subject: PO reference mismatch and spend-cap impact for Stratford invoice
messages:
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@stratford-analytics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@stratford-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO reference mismatch on invoice SA-0426

Hi Priya,

We're getting ready to submit invoice SA-0426 for the onboarding work (April services + one-off data migration). Our AP team has the invoice referencing PO 2026-435, but when we ran it through your invoice portal the expected purchase reference is 2026-453. That mismatch is causing the invoice to be held.

Quick facts:
- Invoice: SA-0426 (total $38,450)
- Vendor PO on our copy: 2026-435
- Your finance portal expects: 2026-453

Can you confirm which PO should be used so we can re-issue the invoice? Also, FYI our submission would push Stratford past the monthly onboarding spend cap we saw in the contract email — can you confirm whether a cap override is possible for July?

Attaching the invoice for reference.

Thanks,
Lara Chen
Head of Professional Services
Stratford Analytics
[Attachment: invoice_SA-0426.pdf (PDF)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@stratford-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO reference mismatch on invoice SA-0426

Hi Lara — thanks for the note and for attaching the invoice. Sorry for the friction here. I'm looping in procurement (Evelyn) and sales (Ben) to get a quick resolution.

Two asks to speed this up:
1) Evelyn — can you confirm whether 2026-435 or 2026-453 is the correct issued PO on our side? If neither, can procurement issue a provisional PO so Stratford can invoice without delay?
2) Lara — can you confirm the line-item breakdown (services, migration, one-time fees) if it's not already on SA-0426? That will help with cost-center assignment.

Ben/Evelyn — this is an onboarding invoice that may push July's spend over the standard onboarding cap. If procurement can provisionally approve a one-month cap increase we can process payment faster; finance will need to record the override.

I'll keep an eye on this and follow up once we have the mapping.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head, Strategic GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@stratford-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO reference mismatch on invoice SA-0426

Thanks for the ping — digging in.

What happened: we recently migrated PO sequencing between the onboarding ledger and the partner services ledger. During the cutover some vendors received provisional numbers (2026-435 series) while the canonical PO registry moved to the 2026-453 series. Stratford appears to have used the provisional number.

Next steps I need from Stratford (Lara):
- Confirm the invoice line-item split (Services: $22,500; Migration: $12,750; Travel/expenses: $3,200) — if those match what's on SA-0426 we're good.
- Confirm billing contact for remittance.

Procurement actions I can take immediately:
- Produce an official mapping that declares 2026-435 -> 2026-453 as the canonical assignment and issue a short PO amendment memo. (I'll attach the mapping doc.)
- For July only, I can recommend a temporary spend cap increase from $75,000 to $95,000 to cover onboarding surges; finance approval required.

Attaching a mapping CSV to coordinate ledger team and AP.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_mapping_sheet.csv (CSV)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO reference mismatch on invoice SA-0426

Quick internal note — I spoke with the Stratford AM team this morning. They confirmed the line items Evelyn listed and said they can resubmit referencing the canonical PO if we provide it.

I'm comfortable approving a provisional PO mapping and one-month cap override for onboarding so Stratford isn't blocked. Marcus — will finance approve the override and handle the reclassing? If yes, I'll confirm to Stratford to reissue the invoice.

Ben
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO reference mismatch on invoice SA-0426

OK to proceed with a provisional mapping and July cap increase to $95,000 with the following controls:
- Recode the line items to cost center ENG-OPS (project: onboarding-2026) so we capture the one-off migration spend separately.
- Finance will process the invoice once Stratford updates the PO reference to 2026-453 and re-submits. We'll post a journal entry to move the amount out of the default SPEND bucket into the onboarding project bucket.
- Please include a short approval memo from procurement with the PO mapping so AP has an audit trail.

I've attached a journal entry template and a short PO adjustment request form — use those when you respond to Stratford.

Marcus Lin
Director, Financial Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: journal_entry_template.xlsx (XLSX)]
[Attachment: po_adjustment_request.docx (DOCX)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@stratford-analytics.com>, accounts-payable@stratford-analytics.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO reference mismatch on invoice SA-0426 — resolution and next steps

Hi Lara — quick update and confirmation:

- Procurement has mapped provisional 2026-435 -> canonical PO 2026-453 and issued the amendment memo.
- Finance approved a one-month spend cap increase to $95,000 for July to cover onboarding surges; Marcus has captured the controls required.
- New PO reference to use on reissued invoice: 2026-453 (please append "-B" for amended submissions, e.g., 2026-453-B).
- Cost center for this invoice: ENG-OPS (onboarding-2026).

Actions for Stratford:
1) Reissue invoice SA-0426 with PO 2026-453-B and the line-item split as quoted.
2) Attach the PO mapping memo and procurement approval to the submission.
3) Send to AP: ap@redwood.ai (we've notified them of the mapping).

We attached the PO mapping CSV, the journal template, and the PO adjustment form to this thread. Once we receive the reissued invoice we'll queue payment and confirm ETA.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Lara — please confirm when the updated invoice is submitted and I'll mark this resolved on our side.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head, Strategic GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
